name: SAGE Camp at SLAC
city: Menlo Park and Palo Alto, CA
what_you_do: You can attend a free one-week science camp for high schoolers from all backgrounds. It has hands-on science on the SLAC and Stanford campuses.
who_can_apply: High school students from all backgrounds. The page lists no age, grade or residency limits. Apply on the Kaleidoscope platform.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Feb 24 to Mar 17, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Kaleidoscope platform when the next cycle opens. It is linked from the SAGE site.
notes: The page says the camp is free. Whether it is overnight, and the 2027 dates, were not on the page I read. Check the SAGE site in February.
